description: Set playback volume on one device, on a selection of devices, or across every live device. `volume_percent` sets an absolute level; `delta_step` nudges the current level by a signed step. `op` picks the variant: "mute" drops to 0 and remembers the level, "unmute" restores what mute remembered, "preset" applies the per-device presets stored by set_device_volume_preset, and "level" with no volume_percent copies the active device's level to the others. Quota: 1 write for a single device; 1 read + N writes when fanning out.

all_devices.description: For op "level" with volume_percent: set every volume-capable device, not a named selection.

delta_step.description: Signed nudge, e.g. +10 or -10, clamped to 0–100. Mutually exclusive with volume_percent.

device_id.description: Device ID for a single-device write (default: the active device)

device_ids.description: For op "level" with volume_percent: fan out to these device ids or names. Mutually exclusive with all_devices.

dry_run.description: Preview only: describe what would change without performing it. Default false — pass true to preview.

exclude_device_id.description: For op "level" with no volume_percent: leave this device untouched while levelling the rest

op.description: Variant: "level" (default) set or copy a level, "mute", "unmute", "preset"

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

volume_percent.description: Absolute level 0–100. Mutually exclusive with delta_step.

name: set_volume
